_comment: A DRILL incident record — FAKE DATA, never a real event. `node tooling/legal/breach-draft.mjs --drill` drafts all three notices from it; tooling/ci/test/breach-draft.test.mjs holds that every required field lands. Copy this shape for a real incident (docs/ops/breach-response.md), never this file.
nature: DRILL: a test bucket of report screenshots was briefly readable through a misconfigured preview link.
extent: DRILL: 12 screenshots, each already blurred on the device; no account data.
location: DRILL: Cloudflare R2, region APAC (bucket nikatru-feedback-drill).
likelyImpact: DRILL: low — the images carry no text fields and no account identifiers.
consequencesForPrincipals: DRILL: someone may have seen a blurred screenshot of the app screen you reported.
mitigation: DRILL: the preview link was revoked at 06:25 UTC and the bucket's public access turned off.
principalSafetySteps: DRILL: nothing is needed from you; if you attached a screenshot you would rather we delete, reply and we will.
rootCause: DRILL: a preview environment inherited a public-read binding.
personResponsible: DRILL: no outside party; an internal configuration error.
remediation: DRILL: preview environments now bind no production bucket; a CI check refuses a public binding.
symptoms: DRILL: an unexpected 200 on the bucket's public URL in ops-watch.
certinActions: DRILL: access revoked, logs preserved (180-day minimised ICT logs on the boxes), principals notified.

decisions.decision: DRILL: treat as a personal data breach; start the 72-hour clock.
DRILL: contained; draft the Board intimation and the user notice.
